title: SEC1: test-utils feature silently skips all integration tests
description: All integration tests in crates/kithd/tests/harness.rs and the new helpers in e2e.rs are gated on #[cfg(feature = 'test-utils')]. Running 'cargo test -p kithd' without '--features test-utils' silently skips all three integration tests (harness_smoke_test, full_message_delivery, offline_delivery_and_retry) and the spawn_test_listener_binds_loopback_port helper. There is no compile-time warning or test output indicating tests were skipped. The module doc in harness.rs mentions the feature requirement (line 15-16) but that is only visible when reading the file, not when running tests. Risk: a contributor adding a test or a CI job running without the feature will see 'ok 0 tests' and assume the suite passed. Mitigation: add a doc-comment or a cfg_attr(not(feature='test-utils'), compile_error\!(...)) stub pointing to the required invocation, or document the feature in the crate's Cargo.toml [features] table with a note.
